notes:
JAVASCRIPT REQUIRED: This site uses a custom <bbcrm> web component system that dynamically loads listings via API. The listings are not present in static HTML. 

Technical Details:
- Uses custom <bbcrm> tags with api_string attributes (e.g., api_string="allListingsB", api_string="sidebarsearchtool")
- Listings appear to be loaded from a proprietary Business Broker CRM (bbcrm) system
- Different pages use different presets to filter listings (e.g., presets="c_listing_askingprice_c :>:0,c_listing_askingprice_c:<:500000" for $0-500k)
- Main search page: http://nocoastbusinessadvisors.com/search-results/?
- Category pages exist: /listings-0-500k/, /listings-500k-1m/, /listings-1m-and-up/, /listings-manufacturing/, /listings-retail/, /listings-services/

SCRAPING REQUIREMENTS:
1. Use Playwright/Selenium/Puppeteer to render JavaScript
2. Wait for bbcrm elements to populate with listing data
3. Alternative: Reverse engineer the bbcrm API endpoints (likely makes XHR/fetch requests)
4. The API may require authentication or API keys

RECOMMENDED APPROACH:
- Use browser automation (Playwright recommended)
- Wait for network idle or specific elements to appear after page load
- Extract data from dynamically rendered DOM
- Or intercept network requests to capture API responses directly
